metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in the United Kingdom increase in February 11-25, 2019 compared to the same period average from 2000-2012?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about land surface temperature (LST) in the UK, comparing February 11-25, 2019 to the average of the same period from 2000-2012. Let me break this down: 1. Data: Need MODIS LST data (MOD11A1 or MOD11A2) which provides daily/8-day land surface temperature 2. Location: United Kingdom - I'll use a polygon covering the UK 3. Time periods: - Baseline: Feb 11-25 for years 2000-2012 (13 years) - Target: Feb 11-25, 2019 4. Processing: Calculate mean LST for each period and compare 5. Masking: MODIS LST has quality flags, so I should mask poor quality pixels Strategy: - Use MOD11A1 (daily) for better temporal resolution - Mask using QC band to remove poor quality pixels - Calculate mean LST for each period - Compare 2019 value to baseline average - Handle cases where data might be missing Potential issues: - MODIS data starts in 2000, so baseline period should be fine - UK in February might have cloud contamination, so careful masking needed - Need to validate results (reasonable temperature ranges) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const ukBounds = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-10.0, 49.0, 2.0, 61.0]); // UK bounding box // Time periods const baselineStart = '2000-02-11'; const baselineEnd = '2012-02-25'; const targetStart = '2019-02-11'; const targetEnd = '2019-02-25'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Land Surface Temperature const modisLST = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']); // Function to process MODIS LST function processLST(image) { const lst = image.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02); // Convert to Kelvin const qc = image.select('QC_Day'); // Mask poor quality pixels (QC bits 0-1 = 00 for good quality) const qualityMask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); return lst.updateMask(qualityMask).subtract(273.15); // Convert to Celsius } // Get baseline data (2000-2012) const baselineCol = modisLST .filterDate(baselineStart, baselineEnd) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(11, 25, 'day_of_year')) .map(processLST); // Get target data (2019) const targetCol = modisLST .filterDate(targetStart, targetEnd) .map(processLST); // Check collection sizes const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); const targetSize = targetCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline images (2000-2012): ${baselineSize}`); console.log(`Target images (2019): ${targetSize}`); if (baselineSize === 0 || targetSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate means const baselineMean = baselineCol.mean(); const targetMean = targetCol.mean(); // Get pixel counts to check for valid data const baselineCount = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: ukBounds, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const targetCount = targetMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: ukBounds, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline valid pixels: ${baselineCount}`); console.log(`Target valid pixels: ${targetCount}`); if (baselineCount === 0 || targetCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean temperatures const baselineTemp = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: ukBounds, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const targetTemp = targetMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: ukBounds, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline temp (2000-2012): ${baselineTemp ? baselineTemp.toFixed(2) : 'N/A'}°C`); console.log(`Target temp (2019): ${targetTemp ? targetTemp.toFixed(2) : 'N/A'}°C`); // Validation & Final Answer if (baselineTemp === null || targetTemp === null || isNaN(baselineTemp) || isNaN(targetTemp) || Math.abs(baselineTemp) > 50 || Math.abs(targetTemp) > 50) { // Unreasonable temps console.log("C3"); } else if (targetTemp > baselineTemp) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
